description: Chipless chocolate chip cookies! 🍪 Recipe for around 8 cookies: ⭐️Ingredients⭐️ 100g unsalted butter, melted 65g brown sugar  55g granulated sugar 1 egg 160g all purpose flour 1 tsp vanilla extract  1/2 tsp baking soda 1/2 tsp salt Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 10-12 minutes! 💕 #baking #baketok #cookies #chiplesscookies #cookiesrecipe #bakingtherapy #fyp
